markets.rules_primary: If the upper bound of the target federal funds rate published on the Federal Reserve's official website is greater than 3.75% following the Federal Reserve's Dec 9, 2026 meeting, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: This market will expire the first 2:05 PM ET following the release of a Federal Reserve statement for their Dec 9, 2026 meeting or one week following the last day of that meeting.
markets.title: Will the upper bound of the federal funds rate be above 3.75% following the Fed's Dec 9, 2026 meeting?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
markets.rules_primary: If the upper bound of the target range for the federal funds rate in effect at 11:59 PM ET on December 31, 2027, as published on the Federal Reserve’s official website, is above 4.00%, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: If the Federal Reserve specifies a single target rate rather than a target range, that target rate will be used.
markets.title: Will the upper bound of the target range for the federal funds rate in effect at 11:59 PM ET on December 31, 2027 be above 4.00%?
